Vendor Rules and Regulations

Rules and Regulations - Spirit of the Fourth (SOTF)

VENDOR APPLICATION AND FEES: Please read all information carefully to request your booth, complete the online application along with the documentation, and send it to the Spirit of the Fourth.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS: All vendors must provide $1,000,000 in general liability coverage certificate (see insurance information for details). A temporary food facility (TFF) is required if you will be providing any type of consumable products.

COMMUNITY FAIR HOURS: The hours of the Community Fair are from 9:00AM. until 12:30PM. Your booth or food truck must be manned and open for business during those hours. Be sure to check in at the Information Booth upon arrival.

RETURNING VENDORS: Thank you for returning as a vendor to our Community Fair. We will do our best to reserve the same spot as in prior years; however, there is no guarantee. Spaces are on a first come basis but are ultimately the discretion of SOTF.

QUALITY OF PRODUCTS: SOTF reserves the right to reject any vendor application which does not meet the quality or design the Spirit of the Fourth is attempting to portray. The SOTF attempts to create an exhibition of crafts, food, and community organizations acceptable to the general public. Any drug paraphernalia or illegal items are strictly prohibited.

COMMUNITY FAIR BOOTHS: A 10’ x 10’ booth space will be allocated. Vendors must provide their own fire-retardant canopy, table, and chairs. (Booths providing consumable products also require three sidewalls.) If a vendor is unable to provide these items, they are available to rent by contacting the fair director listed on the application by May 31. (Rental fees will be determined at that time.) Vendors must only occupy the assigned space to accommodate neighbor booths. They are responsible for providing their own set-ups or any materials needed for their display. Vendors agree to have no open flames at any booth, and tablecloths must be a minimum of six (6) inches off the ground. Vendors agree to abide by any other safety regulations set forth by the Bernardo Town Center Property Owners Association and the City of San Diego Fire Department. At the request of the Bernardo Town Center Property Owners Association, no stakes are allowed to secure your canopy.

SET-UP AND BREAKDOWN: Vendors are allowed to arrive any time after 6:30 a.m. to be set up by 8:45AM. No vehicles will be allowed in the grass area of the fair. There will be an area designated for drop-off and pick-up. Immediately after your items have been unloaded, please park your vehicle in the spaces provided for vendor parking to allow other vehicles to unload. It is suggested to bring carts or wagons. Volunteers will be available to assist with carting your items to your assigned space. For assistance with returning your items to your vehicle, check with the volunteers at the Information Booth. Booth spaces must be kept clean and free of any debris at the end of the event.

EVENING FIREWORK EVENT: Evening event participants are subject to Poway Unified School District rules and regulations. If participating in the evening event, vendors must arrive at Bernardo Heights Middle School prior to 3:00PM, and are required to remain until the end of the fireworks.

REFUNDS: SOTF does not guarantee retail sales, weather, or attendance. There will be NO REFUNDS for cancellations after June 20 of this calendar year.

QUESTIONS OR CONCERNS: A list of frequently asked questions will be sent to vendors prior to the event. If you have concerns or need assistance during the Community Fair, please find a SOTF staff at the Information Booth. The Assistant Director of the Community Fair, Stephanie Tutunjian can be contacted at 858-382-9582.

By submitting the vendor application form, you acknowledge you have read and understand the above Rules and Regulations for the Spirit of the Fourth Community Fair.

Insurance Information

Our insurance provider for the Community Fair event requires that EVERY vendor have the following liability insurance.

The Renter or Lessor shall pay and provide a General Liability Limit in the amount of $1,000,000 and $2,000,000 Policy Aggregate. A certificate of insurance naming the Spirit of the Fourth and the City of San Diego as Additional Insureds must accompany your application or be mailed in no later than June 20 of this calendar year. The Renter agrees to defend, hold harmless and indemnify Spirit of the Fourth for any claim of bodily injury or property damage except for those claims that result from the sole negligence of Spirit of the Fourth.

All vendors must have insurance policies. You must name BOTH the Spirit of the Fourth as well as the City of San Diego as Additional Insureds on your policy.

The following is a resource to purchase required insurance, or you may go with your own insurance:
